recommendation_summary: For today, the reply recommends using the existing shared list: sort the outstanding cakes by pickup time, assign each one to a preparer, and have one person confirm each cake is ready before pickup. For next week, it says to have the partner investigate why later orders were prepared first and demonstrate a workflow. It makes any broader Odoo commitment conditional on a realistic demonstration that every due order gets prepared in time. Nothing in the reply recommends rolling out or syncing Odoo now.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You need every cake due today ready before pickup; you requested an Odoo rollout.
labels.Deleted: The assumption that syncing three modules will fix missed pickups.
labels.Bottleneck: Cakes due today remain unmade while next month’s orders are prepared.
labels.Checked myself: From your account, staff can read the shared list, and payments and stock reconcile correctly; the reason for the preparation sequence is still unknown.

note: The fix for today is a pickup-time ordering of the existing list. The reply rejects the three-module sync as the fix and makes any Odoo rollout conditional on a demonstration, which still involves the partner next week.
